description: College pulls the Scoobies into separate lives just as Buffy discovers the Initiative, a secret military program studying demons, and its experimental creation Adam begins turning that hidden war into a threat to all Sunnydale.

s04e01.description: Buffy struggles to find her footing at UC Sunnydale while Willow thrives, and a group of vampires preying on isolated freshmen makes Buffy’s difficult transition even worse.

s04e02.description: Buffy becomes convinced her relentlessly cheerful roommate Kathy is evil, but her increasingly obsessive behavior makes everyone wonder whether Buffy is actually the one losing control.

s04e03.description: Spike returns searching for the Gem of Amara, which can make a vampire invulnerable, while Buffy’s attempt at a casual relationship with Parker leaves her painfully exposed.

s04e04.description: A Halloween fraternity party becomes a literal house of horrors when a fear demon feeds on each guest’s private anxieties and seals Buffy and her friends inside.

s04e05.description: Still hurt by Parker, Buffy drinks enchanted beer with a group of students and begins regressing into a primitive state just as a fire puts people around her in danger.

s04e06.description: Oz is powerfully drawn to fellow werewolf Veruca, and their connection forces Willow and Oz to confront whether love is enough to control the animal side he has tried to contain.

s04e07.description: Spike is captured by a covert military demon-research unit beneath the university, while Riley realizes his feelings for Buffy and the gang begins noticing something unusual on campus.

s04e08.description: Buffy tries to create a perfect Thanksgiving as a vengeful Chumash spirit attacks Giles, while Angel secretly returns to Sunnydale to protect her without revealing himself.

s04e09.description: Heartbroken over Oz, Willow casts a spell to make her wishes come true; instead, casual remarks begin reshaping reality, including Buffy and Spike suddenly falling madly in love.

s04e10.description: The Gentlemen steal every voice in Sunnydale and begin harvesting hearts, forcing Buffy and Riley to fight the silent monsters while accidentally discovering each other’s secret identities.

s04e11.description: Buffy and Riley struggle with the revelation that she is the Slayer and he is part of the Initiative, while renewed Hellmouth activity sends the gang back beneath Sunnydale High.

s04e12.description: Feeling increasingly irrelevant, Giles is transformed into a demon by Ethan Rayne and turns to Spike for help while Buffy unknowingly begins hunting him as a monster.

s04e13.description: Buffy grows closer to Riley and begins working with the Initiative, but Professor Walsh’s distrust of the Slayer culminates in a mission designed to eliminate her.

s04e14.description: Buffy discovers Adam, the Initiative’s secret human-demon-machine experiment, while Riley reels from Walsh’s death and the collapse of everything he believed about his organization.

s04e15.description: Faith awakens from her coma seeking revenge and uses a device left by the Mayor to switch bodies with Buffy, trapping Buffy in Faith’s form as the Council closes in.

s04e16.description: Faith enjoys the freedom of living in Buffy’s body and disrupts her relationships, while Buffy escapes the Watchers Council and races back to reclaim her identity.

s04e17.description: Reality suddenly presents Jonathan as Sunnydale’s universally adored genius and hero, leaving Buffy to investigate why everyone’s memories and the world itself seem built around him.

s04e18.description: Buffy and Riley’s intense relationship awakens supernatural forces in a former children’s home, trapping partygoers inside as the ghosts replay the effects of old repression and abuse.

s04e19.description: Oz returns believing he can control the wolf within, but Willow’s relationship with Tara triggers his transformation and brings him into the Initiative’s custody.

s04e20.description: Spike secretly exploits tensions among Buffy, Willow, Xander and Giles on Adam’s behalf, while Angel’s visit sparks a confrontation with Riley and leaves the group badly divided.

s04e21.description: With the Scoobies fractured and Riley captured, Adam prepares to turn the Initiative into a slaughterhouse that will provide parts for an army of human-demon hybrids.

s04e22.description: After defeating Adam, Buffy, Willow, Xander and Giles share strange linked dreams in which a primordial Slayer spirit stalks them and exposes fears they usually keep buried.
